## Change

What does this change, and why? Use a Conventional Commit title for a squash PR.

## Evidence

Which commands or manual checks did you run? What did they show, and what did they not cover? Distinguish synthetic checks from live behavior.

## Impact

Call out risks, privacy or compatibility changes, updated docs, and any packaging or release implications. State what still needs approval or verification. Do not include secrets, private reports, or raw transcripts.
